## About
Gambal's Social Club is a low-key bar and grill in Westport, Kansas City. Come in for a drink, rack up a game of pool, throw some darts or pull a block from the Jenga tower with friends.
The kitchen keeps things simple and includes a vegan menu that people make a special trip for. Guests have given us a 4.4 rating across 418 Google reviews, and we'd like to see you add yours.

## Services
- Games: Jenga, pool, darts and more to play while you hang out.
- Vegan menu: A vegan menu that one reviewer came in specifically to try and was highly impressed by.
- Non alcoholic beer: One reviewer was glad to find non alcoholic beers on hand.

## FAQ
Q: Is this a good spot for a late night drink?
A: One reviewer who rolled in after a long drive said it's worth a stop for a late night drink.

Q: Do you have vegan food?
A: Yes. There's a vegan menu, and one reviewer said they were highly impressed by it.

Q: Are drink prices reasonable?
A: One reviewer called the drink prices very reasonable and mentioned a $2.50 PBR.

## What customers say
- "Marky Mark IS THE ABSOLUTE BEST. Aside from him watching over the ladies of the bar but also his ability to make outsiders feel welcome. We left and came back after wandering around because he made such an amazing impression. I am extremely grateful for them having/carrying non alcoholic beers. We will be back & if Marky Mark sees this! COME SEE US IN DES MONIES🫶🏻" (Emma Swalla, 5/5)
- "I rolled into KC after a 9 hour drive and Mark the bartender was amazing!  The place reminded me of a Milwaukee dive bar in all the best ways including how Mark made me feel at home immediately and was ridiculously funny to boot!
The best part was the prices for a drink are very reasonable ($2.50 for a PBR).  Definitely worth a stop for a late night drink.  Cheers!" (Midwest Wanderer, 5/5)
- "Gambles is the place to be! Mark the bartender always treats me with kindness and always makes me laugh! I have a great time every time I’m here and the food is phenomenal. If I could give it 10 stars, I would! The environment and the people are amazing and it’s always a great time to meet with friends play pool darts, and other games!! Just a vibe!" (Shashanna Oberle, 5/5)
- "Came here to try the Vegan menu and was highly impressed. Cauliflower wings were delicious (vegan ranch availiable) and the vegan chicken wrap was huge and full of fresh tasting lettuce tomato’s and grilled Chixn. A nice discovery!!" (Kelly Roos, 5/5)
- "We went in for the vegan menu and were not disappointed! It was absolutely fantastic. The restrooms left room for improvement, but it’s a Westport bar." (James Arcano, 4/5)
